"""Reads the molecules and computes their properties with RDKit. A SMILES that
cannot be read is reported with the reason and skipped."""
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem, RDLogger
from rdkit.Chem import Crippen, Descriptors, Lipinski, rdMolDescriptors

from inputs.pasted.mol.Pasted import Pasted
from tsugumi import Failure
import outputs.molecules.mol.Molecules as out

RDLogger.DisableLog("rdApp.*")  # reasons are shown on the Card instead


def read(smiles):
    """The molecule and None, or None and why it could not be read."""
    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles, sanitize=False)
    if mol is None:
        return None, "SMILES の文法として読めません"
    problems = Chem.DetectChemistryProblems(mol)
    if problems:
        return None, f"化学として成り立ちません（RDKit: {problems[0].Message()}）"
    Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
    return mol, None


def entries(ctx):
    """(name, SMILES) from the list, then the pasted one."""
    p = ctx.params()
    pairs = []
    for i in range(p.MoleculesLength()):
        name, _, smiles = p.Molecules(i).decode().partition(":")
        pairs.append((name.strip(), smiles.strip()) if smiles else (f"#{i + 1}", name.strip()))
    pasted = ctx.input("pasted", Pasted)
    smiles = (pasted.Smiles() or b"").decode().strip()
    if smiles:
        pairs.append(((pasted.Name() or b"pasted").decode().strip() or "pasted", smiles))
    return pairs


def strings(b, items):
    offsets = [b.CreateString(s) for s in items]
    b.StartVector(4, len(offsets), 4)
    for o in reversed(offsets):
        b.PrependUOffsetTRelative(o)
    return b.EndVector()


def main(ctx):
    rows, errors = [], []
    for name, smiles in entries(ctx):
        mol, why = read(smiles)
        if mol is None:
            errors.append(f"**{name}** の SMILES `{smiles}` は計算から外しました: {why}。")
            print(f"skipped {name}: {smiles}: {why}")
            continue
        rows.append(dict(
            name=name, smiles=smiles, formula=rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol),
            mw=Descriptors.MolWt(mol), logp=Crippen.MolLogP(mol), tpsa=rdMolDescriptors.CalcTPSA(mol),
            hbd=rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumHBD(mol), hba=rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumHBA(mol),
            rotatable=rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumRotatableBonds(mol),
            nh_oh=Lipinski.NHOHCount(mol), n_o=Lipinski.NOCount(mol),
        ))
    if not rows:
        raise Failure("output_invalid", "no readable molecule: " + " ".join(errors))

    lines = [*errors, ""] if errors else []
    lines += [f"**{len(rows)} 分子の物性**（RDKit で計算）", "",
              "| 名前 | 分子式 | 分子量 | logP | TPSA (Å²) | HBD | HBA | 回転可能結合 |",
              "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    lines += [f"| {r['name']} | {r['formula']} | {r['mw']:.2f} | {r['logp']:.2f} | {r['tpsa']:.2f} | "
              f"{r['hbd']} | {r['hba']} | {r['rotatable']} |" for r in rows]
    ctx.display_markdown("\n".join(lines))

    b = ctx.builder(8192)
    names, smiles, formula = (strings(b, [r[k] for r in rows]) for k in ("name", "smiles", "formula"))
    doubles = [b.CreateNumpyVector(np.array([r[k] for r in rows], dtype=np.float64)) for k in ("mw", "logp", "tpsa")]
    ints = [b.CreateNumpyVector(np.array([r[k] for r in rows], dtype=np.int32))
            for k in ("hbd", "hba", "rotatable", "nh_oh", "n_o")]
    out.Start(b)
    out.AddNames(b, names)
    out.AddSmiles(b, smiles)
    out.AddFormula(b, formula)
    out.AddMw(b, doubles[0])
    out.AddLogp(b, doubles[1])
    out.AddTpsa(b, doubles[2])
    out.AddHbd(b, ints[0])
    out.AddHba(b, ints[1])
    out.AddRotatable(b, ints[2])
    out.AddNhOh(b, ints[3])
    out.AddNO(b, ints[4])
    ctx.output("molecules", b, out.End(b))

"""The structures as a grid, drawn by RDKit, labelled by matplotlib (which has Japanese glyphs)."""
import math

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Draw

from inputs.molecules.mol.Molecules import Molecules


def main(ctx):
    m = ctx.input("molecules", Molecules)
    n = m.NamesLength()
    cols = min(5, n)
    rows = math.ceil(n / cols)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(rows, cols, figsize=(2.7 * cols, 2.6 * rows), squeeze=False)
    for ax in axes.ravel():
        ax.axis("off")
    for i in range(n):
        ax = axes.ravel()[i]
        ax.imshow(Draw.MolToImage(Chem.MolFromSmiles(m.Smiles(i).decode()), size=(420, 360)))
        ax.set_title(f"{m.Names(i).decode()}\n{m.Formula(i).decode()}", fontsize=10)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

"""Lipinski's rule of five, with his counts: NH + OH for donors, N + O for acceptors."""
import numpy as np

from inputs.molecules.mol.Molecules import Molecules
import outputs.checked.mol.Checked as out

RULES = [("分子量 > 500", "mw", 500), ("logP > 5", "logp", 5), ("NH+OH > 5", "nh_oh", 5), ("N+O > 10", "n_o", 10)]


def strings(b, items):
    offsets = [b.CreateString(s) for s in items]
    b.StartVector(4, len(offsets), 4)
    for o in reversed(offsets):
        b.PrependUOffsetTRelative(o)
    return b.EndVector()


def cell(value, limit, digits=0):
    text = f"{value:.{digits}f}"
    return f"**{text}**" if value > limit else text


def main(ctx):
    m = ctx.input("molecules", Molecules)
    limit = ctx.params().MaxViolations()
    n = m.NamesLength()
    names = [m.Names(i).decode() for i in range(n)]
    formula = [m.Formula(i).decode() for i in range(n)]
    values = dict(mw=m.MwAsNumpy(), logp=m.LogpAsNumpy(), nh_oh=m.NhOhAsNumpy(), n_o=m.NOAsNumpy())
    broken = [[label for label, key, top in RULES if values[key][i] > top] for i in range(n)]
    violations = np.array([len(b) for b in broken], dtype=np.int32)
    passed = violations <= limit
    print(f"{int(passed.sum())} of {n} pass with at most {limit} violations; violations "
          + ", ".join(f"{names[i]} {violations[i]}" for i in range(n)))

    lines = [f"**{n} 分子のうち {int(passed.sum())} 分子が通過**（違反 {limit} 個まで。太字が超過した値）", "",
             "| 名前 | 分子量 | logP | NH+OH | N+O | 違反 | 判定 |", "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for i in range(n):
        lines.append(f"| {names[i]} | {cell(values['mw'][i], 500, 1)} | {cell(values['logp'][i], 5, 2)} | "
                     f"{cell(values['nh_oh'][i], 5)} | {cell(values['n_o'][i], 10)} | {violations[i]} | "
                     f"{'通過' if passed[i] else '**不通過**'} |")
    ctx.display_markdown("\n".join(lines))

    b = ctx.builder(4096)
    names_v = strings(b, names)
    formula_v = strings(b, formula)
    broken_v = strings(b, ["、".join(x) for x in broken])
    doubles = [b.CreateNumpyVector(v) for v in (m.MwAsNumpy(), m.LogpAsNumpy(), m.TpsaAsNumpy())]
    violations_v = b.CreateNumpyVector(violations)
    out.Start(b)
    out.AddNames(b, names_v)
    out.AddFormula(b, formula_v)
    out.AddMw(b, doubles[0])
    out.AddLogp(b, doubles[1])
    out.AddTpsa(b, doubles[2])
    out.AddViolations(b, violations_v)
    out.AddBroken(b, broken_v)
    out.AddMaxViolations(b, limit)
    ctx.output("checked", b, out.End(b))

"""Tanimoto similarity of Morgan fingerprints for every pair of molecules."""
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem, DataStructs
from rdkit.Chem import rdFingerprintGenerator

from inputs.molecules.mol.Molecules import Molecules


def main(ctx):
    m = ctx.input("molecules", Molecules)
    p = ctx.params()
    n = m.NamesLength()
    names = [m.Names(i).decode() for i in range(n)]
    generator = rdFingerprintGenerator.GetMorganGenerator(radius=p.Radius(), fpSize=p.Bits())
    prints = [generator.GetFingerprint(Chem.MolFromSmiles(m.Smiles(i).decode())) for i in range(n)]
    sim = np.array([DataStructs.BulkTanimotoSimilarity(f, prints) for f in prints])
    off = sim - np.eye(n)
    a, b = np.unravel_index(np.argmax(off), off.shape)
    mean = off.sum() / max(n * (n - 1), 1)
    print(f"mean similarity {mean:.4f}; most similar {names[a]} and {names[b]} {sim[a, b]:.4f}")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6.6))
    image = ax.imshow(sim, cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=1)
    ax.set_xticks(range(n), names, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_yticks(range(n), names)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            ax.text(j, i, f"{sim[i, j]:.2f}"[1:] if sim[i, j] < 1 else "1", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                    color="white" if sim[i, j] > 0.55 else "#333333")
    ax.set_title(f"Tanimoto 係数（Morgan 半径 {p.Radius()}）: いちばん近いのは {names[a]} と {names[b]}（{sim[a, b]:.2f}）",
                 fontsize=11)
    fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

notes.html:
分子の物性と Rule of Five

分子を文字列で表す SMILES から、RDKit が物性を計算します。分子量は原子量の和です。

M=∑ini AiM = \sum_i n_i\, A_i

Lipinski の Rule of Five は、経口で吸収されやすい分子の経験則で、次のうち 2 つ以上に違反すると吸収されにくいとされます。

M≤500,log⁡P≤5,NH+OH≤5,N+O≤10M \le 500,\quad \log P \le 5,\quad \mathrm{NH{+}OH} \le 5,\quad \mathrm{N{+}O} \le 10

paste の smiles に SMILES を貼って実行すると、その分子が全部の Card に加わります。読めない SMILES は、落ちずに理由を表示します。

logP は原子の寄与の和（Crippen）による推定で、測定値ではありません。経験則には例外があり、薬としての良し悪しを決めるものではありません。
